from pathlib import Path
from apigateway_http_logs_probe import LogsProbe, stage, REGION, now
p = LogsProbe(Path("/tmp/stackd-gateway-logging-3565d5e/testdata/aws/apigateway/http_log_settings.json"), "000000000000", False)
p.data.update(scope="Owned HTTP logging settings only: one API, two log groups, no compute or regional account-role changes", delivery_inventories=[], supplement_source=settings_capture_source, limitations=["Control-plane state only; no data-plane propagation or partial-update delivery convergence measured."])
p.data["owned"]["access_groups"] = []
p.save()
try:
    p.inventory("baseline")
    for alias in ("first", "second"):
        group = {"alias": alias, "name": "/stackd/http-log-settings/" + p.data["prefix"] + "/" + alias}
        group["arn"] = f"arn:aws:logs:{REGION}:{p.data['account']}:log-group:{group['name']}"
        p.required("create-group-" + alias, "logs", "create_log_group", {"logGroupName": group["name"]})
        p.data["owned"]["access_groups"].append(group)
        p.save()
    p.required("create-api", "apigatewayv2", "create_api", {"Name":p.data["prefix"],"ProtocolType":"HTTP"}, own=("http_api","ApiId"))
    first, second = p.data["owned"]["access_groups"]
    stage(p,"create-stage",method="create_stage")
    stage(p,"set-full",AccessLogSettings={"DestinationArn":first["arn"],"Format":"$context.requestId"})
    stage(p,"set-format-only",AccessLogSettings={"Format":'$context.requestId $context.status'})
    stage(p,"set-destination-only",AccessLogSettings={"DestinationArn":second["arn"]})
    stage(p,"set-empty-object",AccessLogSettings={})
    stage(p,"set-empty-format",required=False,AccessLogSettings={"Format":""})
    stage(p,"read-after-empty-format",method="get_stage")
    stage(p,"delete-access-settings",method="delete_access_log_settings")
    stage(p,"read-after-delete",method="get_stage")
    stage(p,"set-unconfigured-format-only",required=False,AccessLogSettings={"Format":"$context.requestId"})
    stage(p,"restore-full",AccessLogSettings={"DestinationArn":first["arn"],"Format":"$context.extendedRequestId"})
    p.inventory("configured")
    p.data["capture_complete"] = True
    p.save()
except Exception as error:
    p.data["failure"] = {"type":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error)}
    p.save()
    raise
finally:
    p.cleanup()
